name: Cognitive Maze v2.5.3 - Alt+Tab Crash Prevention & Assessment Score Precision
notes: Version 2.5.3: Resolves Alt+Tab crashes via borderless fullscreen display mode and exception boundaries; eliminates CPU burn when minimized via idle throttling; resets stuck key modifiers and gesture states on focus transitions; separates fractional answered items from 100-point scaled score in Assessment Selection modal; fixes sequential unlocking for teacher-added assessments; auto-enters portals upon final puzzle completion; character speed boosted to 2.5 while maintaining 60 FPS on AMD A4-6300 hardware.
